note: Attacker-controlled input of 32768 bytes is copied into the 32768-byte global static_data buffer, filling it completely.
Config parser initialized with static_data and size 32768; lexer.end set to static_data + 32767 (last valid byte).
lexer.end points to the last byte of the 32768-byte global buffer; any read past this is out of bounds.
parse_config calls lex_next; the first character '=' produces LEXEME_EQUAL.
The '=' character causes parse_config to transition to parse_key_value.
parse_key_value calls lex_next to process the value; the next input is ''' which triggers lex_multiline_string.
Input contains ''' so lex_config detects a multiline string and transitions to lex_multiline_string.
peek() returns the second quote character, so the closing delimiter is set to '''.
pos advances past the opening ''' to index 4; the remaining bytes are all 'a' with no closing ''' delimiter.
Loop scans for closing ''' but never finds it; pos advances through the buffer via next().
When pos reaches the last valid byte (static_data[32767]), strncmp reads 3 bytes: static_data[32767], static_data[32768], static_data[32769]. The latter two are past the 32768-byte global buffer.
GLOBAL-BUFFER-OVERFLOW READ: strncmp reads bytes beyond the end of the global static_data buffer, triggering ASAN.
